en: What? You, Michael-sama?!{wait}{clear}
No need to look so surprised, is there? Or am I not good enough for you?{wait}{clear}
N-no! Not at all, not in the least!!{wait}{clear}
N-no! Not... not at all.{wait}{clear}
Then why not tell me about it?{wait}{clear}
Yes...{wait}{clear}Um... In Arcaya, the world below that I am guarding, there are stones called Demon Stones. What are they?{wait}{clear}
Yes...{wait}{clear}...In Arcaya, the world below that I am guarding, there are stones called Demon Stones. What exactly are they?{wait}{clear}
Something happened involving that stone, didn't it?{wait}{clear}
I see... I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
Sorry...? What do you mean, Michael-sama?{wait}{clear}
That... that stone is a fragment of Satan's soul, which I shattered...{wait}{clear}

In the war with the fallen angels, I couldn't wipe out Satan's existence completely.{wait}{clear}The soul of the Satan I defeated shattered, and its fragments scattered across many worlds.{wait}{clear}
Aren't those fragments dangerous? To just leave them as they are...{wait}{clear}

I knew they were dangerous, of course. But we cannot touch those stones.{wait}{clear}Touching them wounds us gravely... Though the pain isn't the only reason we keep our hands off them...{wait}{clear}
But then the world below would...{wait}{clear}

No... we have no choice but to leave it all to humans. Even if that seems irresponsible.{wait}{clear}What we hope for is that humans of righteous heart will guard the Demon Stones...{wait}{clear}Besides, the bonds between angels, fallen angels and humans aren't so simple that you can neatly divide them.{wait}{clear}Sad as that is...{wait}{clear}Even as angels... no, precisely because we are angels, we can become fallen angels, or even humans... Do you understand what that means?{wait}{clear}
You struggle with it too, don't you? Especially while guarding the world below...{wait}{clear}
Michael-sama...?{wait}{clear}

Ah, I'm rambling about things that have nothing to do with this.{wait}{clear}Still, if that stone turned up in Arcaya and you came across it, I can't help sensing an evil will behind it...{wait}{clear}
Yes... It seems someone is gathering the Demon Stones.{wait}{clear}
I see... One of the fallen angels is behind it... but who...{wait}{clear}
I'm truly sorry for what I'm putting you all through... You face danger in the world below, and all I can give you is words...{wait}{clear}
No, Michael-sama. Being able to talk with you like this is more than enough.{wait}{clear}

I see... Just hearing you say that means a lot. I hope we can talk like this again.{wait}{clear}I'll tell Raphael about the Demon Stones. You'd best hurry back to the world below. All the more so if that's what's happening.{wait}{clear}
Yes, I understand.{wait}{clear}Thank you so much, Michael-sama. Please excuse me.{wait}{clear}
Be very careful. The fallen angels always fight dirty.{wait}{clear}
Yes!{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry for calling you so suddenly.{wait}{clear}
No, please don't worry about that.{wait}{clear}The fairy told me you wanted to talk. Has something happened?{wait}{clear}
No... um... it's not really... I'm sorry, Angel.{wait}{clear}The fairy told me you would come if I called... I just wanted to talk with you a little...{wait}{clear}
So that's what it was...{n}
Call me anytime.{n}
So that's what it was... That's perfectly fine.{wait}{clear}But I'm glad... I thought something had happened to you, Cecia.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, Angel... It seems I only made you worry.{wait}{clear}
Don't worry about it, Cecia. If anything comes up, please don't hesitate to call me.{wait}{clear}
Yes, thank you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Call me anytime. That is part of my duty, after all.{wait}{clear}
Angel... I'm relieved to hear you say that.{wait}{clear}
Try not to be so tense, Cecia.{wait}{clear}
Yes, I will. Thank you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
What is it? Is something on your mind?{wait}{clear}
No, it isn't that. I just thought it would be nice to talk with you a little, Angel... Was that a bother?{wait}{clear}
It's all right.{n}
I don't have much time...{n}
It's all right with me. Please don't be so considerate.{wait}{clear}
Really...? Thank goodness...{wait}{clear}You always seem so busy, Angel, so I was worried it would be wrong of me to be selfish.{wait}{clear}
Not at all. I don't think of it as selfish. This is part of my duty too.{wait}{clear}
Then, would you keep me company for a little while?{wait}{clear}
Yes, gladly.{wait}{clear}
Um... I don't have much time. I can't stay long, but is that all right?{wait}{clear}

You really are busy, aren't you?{wait}{clear}I'm sorry, Angel. I'm the one being selfish.{wait}{clear}It wasn't anything that important I wanted to talk about, so I'll save it for another time.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, Cecia...{wait}{clear}
No, Angel, please don't worry about it. Do come again, all right?{wait}{clear}
Sorry... for calling you out.{wait}{clear}
No... it's all right. Um, the fairy said you had something to tell me...{wait}{clear}
No... Sorry, but I wanted to test what an angel really is...{wait}{clear}
It can't be helped...{n}
So that was it...{n}
I'm sure it can't be helped that you'd think that way, Clive.{wait}{clear}I think it's hard for anyone to simply believe in beings like us.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... But I feel like I understand you a little better now.{wait}{clear}
I see. I'm glad to hear you say that.{wait}{clear}
So that was it...{wait}{clear}For a human like you, Clive, the existence of angels must be hard to accept...{wait}{clear}
No... It's true, but...{wait}{clear}My fault...{wait}{clear}
No, please don't worry. I believe we'll come to understand each other from here on.{wait}{clear}
Not at all. Do you need something, Clive?{wait}{clear}
No, I just... wanted to talk a little...{n}{wait}{clear}
I don't have much time...{n}
Yes, of course I don't mind. Call me like this anytime.{wait}{clear}
I see... That helps, hearing that.{wait}{clear}Sorry, but... keep me company for a bit.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, I don't have much time... I can't stay long. Is that all right?{wait}{clear}
I see... You're busy...{wait}{clear}It's nothing important... Sorry for calling you. Go on back.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, Clive...{wait}{clear}
Sorry for calling you all of a sudden.{wait}{clear}
The fairy said you had something to tell me. Has something happened, Irene?{wait}{clear}
Well... The fairy said you'd come if I called, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, so I wanted to test if it was true.{wait}{clear}
Now you believe me, right?{n}
So that was it...{wait}{clear}I suppose beings like us really are hard to understand?{wait}{clear}
No, it's not like that.{wait}{clear}But you're not human, so of course there's a lot I'm curious about.{wait}{clear}Still, maybe this wasn't a nice way to go about it. Sorry, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
No, it's fine. If we can understand each other little by little like this...{wait}{clear}
I'm glad to hear you say that too.{wait}{clear}
Now you believe me, right?{wait}{clear}
Yeah, that you'll come, anyway. And I can see you're really the serious type.{wait}{clear}
Then next time, please call me when you need something.{wait}{clear}
I guess. But you're not mad I called you for something like this? I thought you'd be angrier...{wait}{clear}
When called, it is an angel's duty to go to that hero.{wait}{clear}
Oh, is that so...{wait}{clear}I get it, loud and clear. Bye, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
What is it? Is something on your mind?{wait}{clear}
It's nothing that serious. I just wanted to talk with you a little, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Was it a bother, calling you for that?{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... right now...{n}
No, not at all. Call me anytime.{wait}{clear}
That's a relief to hear. You always look so busy... I wasn't sure.{wait}{clear}But having you come like this, I feel like I understand you a little, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Really? Then I'm glad too.{wait}{clear}
You are? Then I'm glad I had the fairy call you. So, will you keep me company for a bit?{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... I don't really have time right now...{wait}{clear}
Oh, fine... So you are busy.{wait}{clear}It'd be wrong to make you stay, and it wasn't anything important, so maybe next time.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... Irene...{wait}{clear}
Don't worry about it. You're the serious type, so it can't be helped.{wait}{clear}See you.{wait}{clear}
Sorry to call you out, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Yes... the fairy said you had something to tell me.{wait}{clear}
Not exactly... In truth, I had you called because I wanted to know your resolve as an angel.{wait}{clear}
Did this tell you anything?{n}
